subject.value: foreground instructional frame for the teaching figure 'The Week 2 keyboard window, B3 to C5'

visual_structure.value: ONE isolated luminous foreground FRAME on pure white: a thin-walled translucent glass-and-watercolor cartouche whose wall is NARROW (under 9% of the canvas width on every side) and fills nearly the whole canvas, surrounding ONE single very large, quiet, near-white milky glass clearing that covers at least 78% of the canvas width and at least 78% of its height, perfectly empty of texture, ornament, objects and dark colour. The clearing is ONE clean rounded-rectangular window, centred, with NO mullions, crossbars, dividers or panes. The frame OUTLINE is ALWAYS a clean rounded rectangle (optionally a softly arched top edge) with straight parallel sides, never an oval, twin lobes, L-shape, staircase or any lobed silhouette. The musical relationship is expressed ONLY through the small ornament motifs that sit ON the narrow glass wall and corners, as follows (take these as rim motifs, never as structure or separate shapes): a long low keyboard-shaped terrace window: a wide shallow arch with fine vertical glass ribbing along its lower rim like soft piano resonance, no keys drawn. Nothing intrudes into the clearing, nothing forms a second clearing, no separate islands. Rich fine filigree, layered translucent glass, a few thin concentric halo lines and warm inner luminance live only on the wall. At least 4% pure white margin outside the frame on all canvas sides.

accent_identity.value: neutral warm plum, pearl-ivory and soft gold-white glass only; NO interval hue coding, no rainbow, no amber-versus-violet pairing

negative_space.value: everything outside the object is empty pure white (#FFFFFF): no wash, mist, glow field, swirl, texture, paper grain, vignette, ground or shadow

background.value: pure flat white (#FFFFFF) isolation for alpha extraction; soft organic translucent edges fading cleanly to white; nothing touches the canvas edge; no rectangle
